module: Node "Is Bus" (category `repeat_instant`). Tests whether a vehicle is a bus via `mgr.modules.vehicle:isBus(vehId)`. Input pin: `vehId`. Outputs: flow `isBus`, flow `isNotBus`, bool `isBusBool`.
notes: The description of the input pin says "Id of vehicle A" (copy-paste); it is indeed the tested vehicle.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Fills `isBus`, `isNotBus` and `isBusBool` according to the result of `isBus`. Parameter `args` unused.
